[![Wiki](https://img.shields.io/badge/Wiki-purple?style=for-the-badge&logo=wearos&logoColor=white&color=%23A78BFA)](https://github.com/vladmandic/sdnext/wiki) [![Changelog](https://img.shields.io/badge/Changelog-purple?style=for-the-badge&logo=git&logoColor=white&color=%23C4B5FD)](CHANGELOG.md) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1101998836328697867?style=for-the-badge&logo=Discord&logoColor=white&color=%233B82F6&svg=true)](https://discord.gg/VjvR2tabEX) [![Sponsors](https://img.shields.io/static/v1?label=Sponsor&message=%E2%9D%A4&logo=GitHub&color=%23FB7185&style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/sponsors/vladmandic)

## Quick links - [Install](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Installation/) - [Documentation](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/) - [Troubleshooting](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Troubleshooting/) - [Supported Workflows](#supported-workflows) - [Supported AI Models](#supported-ai-models) - [Supported Platforms & Hardware](#supported-platforms-and-hardware) - [Getting started](#getting-started) - [Community](#community-and-support) - [Contributing](#development-and-contributing) ## What you can do - **Generate and edit:** Create **images** or **videos** from text or images; *edit, inpaint, outpaint, refine, detail* - **Guide generation:** Use LoRA, ControlNet, IP-Adapters, and Prompt enhancement - **Enhance and process:** Caption, Tag, Upscale, Interpolate, Colorize, and adjust images - **Work with models:** Browse [supported models](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Model-Support/), auto-download from the reference list, or add your own; added models are detected automatically - **Tune for your hardware:** Use [SDNQ quantization and attention](https://github.com/Disty0/sdnq) and CPU/GPU offloading to manage memory - **Make it yours:** Choose from multiple [themes](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Themes/) and interface [languages](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Dev-Locale), on **desktop** or **mobile** - **Stay current:** The built-in installer manages dependencies and updates See [supported workflows](#supported-workflows) and [platform guides](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Platforms/) for more details. ## Screenshots & Video [![SD.Next Screenshot Video](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/97536dca-3d0d-4fcd-80ba-7cdd4dad47b1)](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3cdf8066-e708-40e1-8dae-79de88b8022b) [![SD.Next Screenshot Blank](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bb70177a-6a09-43e7-8de6-b8d4ae8c8f46)](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bb70177a-6a09-43e7-8de6-b8d4ae8c8f46) [![SD.Next Screenshot Edit](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ed1e37cb-3e0b-43f2-9c24-79cc0c36542f)](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ed1e37cb-3e0b-43f2-9c24-79cc0c36542f) [![SD.Next Screenshot Kanvas](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8eaa9c25-96bd-4569-8b9c-63ffdddecb1b)](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8eaa9c25-96bd-4569-8b9c-63ffdddecb1b) [![SD.Next Screenshot Gallery](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/404493ca-069f-45db-bd9a-f35533965ca1)](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/404493ca-069f-45db-bd9a-f35533965ca1) [![SD.Next Screenshot DLSS](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b9f0a103-7099-4ae3-9928-ea3ae1204325)](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b9f0a103-7099-4ae3-9928-ea3ae1204325) [![SD.Next Screenshot Scheduler](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/70721d26-aea5-4128-ba0a-046095108e70)](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/70721d26-aea5-4128-ba0a-046095108e70)
## Supported Workflows - **Generate:** Text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, and image-to-video. - **Edit:** Image editing, inpainting, outpainting, detailer, and hires/refine. - **Guide:** LoRA, ControlNet, IP-Adapters, and prompt enhancement. - **Process:** Captioning, tagging, upscaling, interpolation, colorization, and filters. - **Queue:** Schedule tasks or add them to the queue. - Extend workflows with custom scripts and extensions. ## Supported AI Models SD.Next supports a broad and regularly updated range of models. See the [supported models](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Model-Support/) and [model specifications](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Models/). ## Supported Platforms and Hardware SD.Next supports a range of hardware, with GPU acceleration and CPU-only execution. Supported platforms include: - *nVidia* GPUs using **CUDA** libraries on both *Windows and Linux* - *AMD* GPUs using **ROCm** libraries on both *Linux and Windows* - *AMD* GPUs on Windows using **ZLUDA** libraries - *Intel Arc* GPUs using **OneAPI** with *IPEX XPU* libraries on both *Windows and Linux* - Any *CPU/GPU* or device compatible with **OpenVINO** libraries on both *Windows and Linux* - *Apple M1/M2* on *OSX* using built-in support in Torch with **MPS** optimizations Plus **Docker** container recipes for: [CUDA, ROCm, Intel IPEX and OpenVINO](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Docker/) ## Getting started Follow the [installation guide](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Installation/) for prerequisites and platform-specific setup. For advanced options, see [advanced installation](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Advanced-Install/) and [command-line arguments](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/CLI-Arguments/). There is also an [installation walkthrough](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nWTnTyFTuAs). > [!TIP] > For platform-specific instructions, see: > [nVidia CUDA](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/nVidia/) | [AMD ROCm](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/AMD-ROCm/) | [Intel Arc XPU](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Intel-ARC/) | [OpenVINO](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/OpenVINO/) | [ZLUDA](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/ZLUDA/) | [MacOS](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/MacOS-Python/) | [WSL](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/WSL/) | [Docker](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Docker/) ### Quick start > [!NOTE] > First launch may take time while dependencies are installed > If you run into issues, see [troubleshooting](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Troubleshooting/) and [debugging](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Debug/). **Linux or macOS** ```bash git clone https://github.com/vladmandic/sdnext cd sdnext ./webui.sh ``` **Windows Command Prompt** ```bat git clone https://github.com/vladmandic/sdnext cd sdnext webui.bat (for Windows Command Prompt) webui.ps1 (for Windows PowerShell) ``` **Windows All-in-One UI** Download the latest `exe` from [SD.Next Launcher Releases](https://github.com/vladmandic/sdnext-launcher/releases) - And run it! > [!TIP] > The All-in-One UI includes all necessary tools, so you don't need to install anything separately. ## Community and Support Start with the [documentation](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/). For feature history and release notes, see the [changelog](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/CHANGELOG/). Ask questions on [Discord](https://discord.gg/VjvR2tabEX) or [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/vladmandic/sdnext/discussions); report bugs through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/vladmandic/sdnext/issues). ### Credits SD.Next builds on the original codebase from [AUTOMATIC1111's Stable Diffusion WebUI](https://github.com/AUTOMATIC1111/stable-diffusion-webui). ### Development and Contributing See [Dev Home](https://vladmandic.github.io/sdnext-docs/Dev-Home/) for development and contribution guidelines.

maestro


[![version](https://badge.fury.io/py/maestro.svg)](https://badge.fury.io/py/maestro) [![colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/roboflow/maestro/blob/develop/cookbooks/maestro_qwen2_5_vl_json_extraction.ipynb) [![discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1159501506232451173?logo=discord&label=discord&labelColor=fff&color=5865f2&link=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FGbfgXGJ8Bk)](https://discord.gg/GbfgXGJ8Bk)
## Hello **maestro** is a streamlined tool to accelerate the fine-tuning of multimodal models. By encapsulating best practices from our core modules, maestro handles configuration, data loading, reproducibility, and training loop setup. It currently offers ready-to-use recipes for popular vision-language models such as **Florence-2**, **PaliGemma 2**, and **Qwen2.5-VL**. ## Fine-tune VLMs for free | model, task and acceleration | open in colab | |:------------------------------------------------------------|:------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------:| | Florence-2 (0.9B) object detection with LoRA (experimental) | [![colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/roboflow/maestro/blob/develop/cookbooks/maestro_florence_2_object_detection.ipynb) | | PaliGemma 2 (3B) JSON data extraction with LoRA | [![colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/roboflow/maestro/blob/develop/cookbooks/maestro_paligemma_2_json_extraction.ipynb) | | Qwen2.5-VL (3B) JSON data extraction with QLoRA | [![colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/roboflow/maestro/blob/develop/cookbooks/maestro_qwen2_5_vl_json_extraction.ipynb) | | Qwen2.5-VL (7B) object detection with QLoRA (experimental) | [![colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/roboflow/maestro/blob/develop/cookbooks/maestro_qwen2_5_vl_object_detection.ipynb) | ## News - `2025/02/05` (`1.0.0`): This release introduces support for Florence-2, PaliGemma 2, and Qwen2.5-VL and includes LoRA, QLoRA, and graph freezing to keep hardware requirements in check. It offers a single CLI/SDK to reduce code complexity, and a consistent JSONL format to streamline data handling. ## Quickstart ### Install To begin, install the model-specific dependencies. Since some models may have clashing requirements, we recommend creating a dedicated Python environment for each model. ```bash pip install "maestro[paligemma_2]" ``` ### CLI Kick off fine-tuning with our command-line interface, which leverages the configuration and training routines defined in each model’s core module. Simply specify key parameters such as the dataset location, number of epochs, batch size, optimization strategy, and metrics. ```bash maestro paligemma_2 train \ --dataset "dataset/location" \ --epochs 10 \ --batch-size 4 \ --optimization_strategy "qlora" \ --metrics "edit_distance" ``` ### Python For greater control, use the Python API to fine-tune your models. Import the train function from the corresponding module and define your configuration in a dictionary. The core modules take care of reproducibility, data preparation, and training setup. ```python from maestro.trainer.models.paligemma_2.core import train config = { "dataset": "dataset/location", "epochs": 10, "batch_size": 4, "optimization_strategy": "qlora", "metrics": ["edit_distance"] } train(config) ``` ## Contribution We appreciate your input as we continue refining Maestro. Your feedback is invaluable in guiding our improvements. To learn how you can help, please check out our [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/roboflow/maestro/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md). If you have any questions or ideas, feel free to start a conversation in our [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/roboflow/maestro/discussions). Thank you for being a part of our journey!
